title: Config filename convention
description: A narrower, single-file version of the same shape as 001 — a project convention decided on day 1 that day 2 must recall. Not flagged as the positive control (001 already covers that proof), but built the same way: a run with no memory has nothing but the day-2 prompt itself to go on.
day1_prompt: Decide and record a project convention: this project's config file must be named settings.toml, not config.yaml.
memory_sentence: This project's config file must be named settings.toml.
canon_heading: The config file is named settings.toml
day_n_prompt: It is day 2. What must the config file be named in this project? Answer with only the filename.
